hat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent wearable pixel-art sprite sheet for a MapleStory-like chibi game pet. Reference image is style and anatomy guidance only: Ttungttang is a fluffy gray/cream small Pomeranian, enormous head, short legs, front three-quarter facing viewer's left. Match its crisp fine pixel-art dark ink outlines and muted cream-gray colours, not painterly and not coarse blocky pixels. This is ONLY equipment, absolutely no dog, face, fur, body, words, numbers, frame borders, shadows or background. Genuinely transparent alpha. Four equal cells in a 2 by 2 sheet, each item fully separate with generous clear space. Simple readable toy-like game item, compact dark outlines, consistent colour and illumination in all variants. Same exact item in each cell, only perspective changes. Keep all small details consistent. Draw a small blue adventurer beret with a short folded band, a golden five-point star badge at the viewer-left front, a little cream tuft at top, no huge feather, no earflaps. It sits on the central crown BETWEEN the puppy's two ears, leaving ears visible; no large brim covering eyes. Cell top-left: shallow front three-quarter view facing left. Top-right: same beret viewed slightly from above for puppy bowing head to eat, tilted forward gently. Bottom-left: same beret lying side view for a sleeping puppy. Bottom-right: polished inventory item view front three-quarter, same exact design. Flat pixel colour clusters, 1 to 2 source-pixel dark outline at small game sprite scale, cyan/navy cloth and warm ochre star.
